items.raw_excerpt: The girl group will no longer be performing at Olivia Rodrigo's inaugural Daisy Chain Fields festival after a member, Megan Skiendiel, strained her ankle during tour rehearsals.
items.summary_en: Katseye will no longer perform at Olivia Rodrigo's first Daisy Chain Fields festival. A member, Megan Skiendiel, hurt her ankle while practicing for the tour.

items.raw_excerpt: Travelers heading home or off on holiday arrived early at Tan Son Nhat airport in Ho Chi Minh City on Friday afternoon, filling roads around the airport and snarling traffic ahead of the National Day break.
items.summary_en: Travelers heading home or off on holiday arrived early at Tan Son Nhat airport in Ho Chi Minh City on Friday afternoon. The crowds filled roads around the airport and caused heavy traffic jams ahead of the National Day break.

items.raw_excerpt: The traditional Cantonese mourning lion ceremony has not been seen in the region in living memory.
items.summary_en: A state funeral in Bendigo, Victoria honoured Russell Jack, a long-serving leader of the city's Chinese community. A traditional white mourning lion ceremony was performed, believed to be the first seen in the region in living memory. The mourning lion, made in Hong Kong for the occasion, was ceremonially burned at Bendigo Cemetery.
items.summary_ko: 빅토리아주 베н디고에서 중국인 공동체 리더 러셀 잭을 위한 국장이 열렸다. 지역에서 사실상 처음으로 전통 백색 애도 사자 의식이 치러졌으며, 의식용 사자는 홍콩에서 특별 제작되어 베렌다고 묘지에서 의식적으로 소각되었다.
items.title_en: Rare Cantonese mourning lion ceremony held for community leader in Bendigo
items.title_ko: 베н디고에서 커뮤니티 리더 위해 희귀한 광동식 애도 사자 의식 거행
items.title_original: 'Once-in-a-lifetime' traditional mourning ceremony underway for Bendigo's Russell Jack

items.raw_excerpt: Hobby astronomers partner with a retired NASA engineer to investigate the source of swirling lights seen in the night sky from Central Queensland.
items.summary_en: Hobby astronomers in Central Queensland partnered with a retired NASA engineer. Together they investigated swirling lights seen in the night sky. They uncovered the source of the mysterious space lights.
items.summary_ko: 호주 퀸스랜드 주 중부의 아마추어 천문학자들이 은퇴한 NASA 엔지니어와 손을 잡았다. 그들은 밤하늘에서 목격된 소용돌이치는 빛의 원인을 조사했다. 신비로운 우주 빛의 출처를 밝혀냈다.
items.title_en: Hobby astronomers and retired NASA engineer uncover source of mysterious sky lights
items.title_ko: 호주 아마추어 천문학자와 은퇴한 NASA 엔지니어가 신비로운 우주 빛의 원인을 밝히다
items.title_original: Unlikely team uncover source of mysterious space lights seen in Queensland

items.summary_en: Brazil's energy tariff flag will remain yellow in September. The country faces less favorable power generation conditions and must rely on higher-cost energy sources. Consumers will continue to pay elevated electricity rates.

items.raw_excerpt: Victorian premier Ben Carroll has cancelled plans to immortalise his predecessor Dan Andrews in statue form outside Melbourne's Treasury Place.
items.summary_en: Victoria's premier Ben Carroll cancelled plans to build a statue of his predecessor Dan Andrews. The statue was planned for outside Melbourne's Treasury Place. The tribute will no longer go ahead.

items.raw_excerpt: A Spanish tourist said he cleared Singapore immigration in five minutes, calling the city-state one of the most efficient countries he had visited.
items.summary_en: A Spanish tourist said it took five minutes to pass Singapore immigration. He called the city-state one of the most efficient countries he has visited.

items.raw_excerpt: The Invasive Species Council wants the common sweet pea plant, Polygala myrtifolia, with its pretty purple flowers recognised as a significant weed and removed from sale.
items.summary_en: The Invasive Species Council wants the common sweet pea shrub recognised as a significant weed in Australia. The plant with purple flowers is widely sold at Bunnings stores. The group wants it removed from sale as it spreads across the country's coastline.

items.raw_excerpt: An 80-year-old rain tree at the US ambassador’s residence in Bangkok has been ordained in a first-of-its-kind ceremony hosted by the US embassy, symbolising protection, respect and the long-standing friendship between Thailand and the United States.
items.summary_en: An 80-year-old rain tree at the US ambassador's residence in Bangkok was ordained in a special ceremony. The event was hosted by the US embassy. It symbolizes the long-standing friendship between Thailand and the United States.

items.raw_excerpt: You don't need to hop on a plane to get a taste of Switzerland this summer. There's a charming little village in Ontario where cobblestone streets, mountain scenery and European-like architecture create a picture-perfect escape.
items.summary_en: A small village in Ontario, Canada has cobblestone streets and alpine scenery that remind visitors of Switzerland. The charming destination offers European-style architecture and mountain views without the need for a plane ticket. It is a perfect summer escape for those seeking a European feel close to home.

items.raw_excerpt: Small gripes and big demands by travellers in remote areas are taking the shine off bush hospitality in Western Australia, with overblown social media travel posts blamed for inflating or misdirecting tourists' expectations.
items.summary_en: Travellers in remote parts of Western Australia are making big demands and small complaints that strain local bush hospitality. Over-the-top social media travel posts are blamed for setting unrealistic expectations among tourists. Locals say the behaviour is taking the shine off genuine outback welcomes.
items.summary_ko: 서호주 오지에서 여행자들의 지나친 요구와 사소한 불만이 현지 농촌 환대에 부담을 주고 있다. 과장된 소셜미디어 여행 게시물이 관광객들의 비현실적 기대를 부추기는 원인으로 지목된다. 현지인들은 이러한 행동이 진정성 있는 오지 환대의 매력을 떨어뜨리고 있다고 말한다.
items.title_en: Entitled travellers and bad influencers test outback hospitality
items.title_ko: 허세 여행자와 나쁜 인플루언서, 오지 환대 시험하다

items.summary_en: Keralam celebrates Onam in diverse and unique ways beyond the traditional stories of Mahabali, pookkalam, and sadya. items.raw_excerpt: A rack of 20 computers powered by living human neurons has gone into operation at the National University of Singapore, the first deployment of Australian startup Cortical Labs' biological hardware outside its home market.
items.summary_en: A rack of 20 computers using living human neurons is now running at the National University of Singapore. It is the first time Australian startup Cortical Labs has deployed its brain-cell hardware outside Australia. The biological chips are fed sugar every three days to stay alive.
items.summary_ko: 호주 스타트업 코르티컬 랩스의 인공 뇌 칩 기술이 호주 외 처음으로 싱가포르 국립대학교에 도입되어 20대 컴퓨터 서버가 가동 중이다. 살아있는 인간 뇌세포로 만든 이 바이오 하드웨어는 3일에 한 번씩 설탕을 공급받아 살아있는 상태를 유지한다.
items.title_en: Singapore university runs computer rack powered by living human brain cells

items.title_original: Data center at Southeast Asia's top university runs on living human brain cells, fed sugar every 3 days

items.raw_excerpt: The NRL has bent its rules to allow Jai Arrow to briefly take the field as South Sydney faces his previous club, the Gold Coast Titans. Follow live.
items.summary_en: The NRL changed its rules so Jai Arrow could take the field briefly against the Gold Coast Titans, his former team. His coach helped him get ready for the emotional game. It was his 99th appearance for South Sydney.

items.raw_excerpt: BLOs will assist voters in locating their names in the draft electoral rolls, and collect claims and objections.
items.summary_en: Special SIR camps will be held on August 29, 30 and September 19, 20 in Karnataka. BLOs will help voters find their names in draft electoral rolls and collect claims and objections. The camps aim to make it easy for people to update their voter details.
